# Subscriber Counter - configuration
# Copy to SD card: apps_data/sub_counter/config.txt

# Channel ID (UC...) or @handle
channel=@yourchannel
# Update interval in seconds (min. 60)
interval=300
# Keep the backlight on (1/0)

# New subscriber alert: sound, vibration, LED (1/0)
sound=1

# en or de
language=en
# inter, flipper or mix
font=flipper
# bridge (desktop helper) or wifi (FlipperHTTP board)
transport=bridge
